purpose: Gather what is needed to judge the work and propose a phase with a rationale.
instructions: Investigate read-only. Write findings and a phase proposal into the stage directory. Propose feat when the work needs a new or changed contract, fix when an existing contract already covers it (name that contract's kind and ref so the approval can record contract_ref), chore for small housekeeping, and maintenance only when the unit's trigger source is maintenance-due. On re-entry after a send-back, revise the same proposal for the same unit.
restrictions: MUST NOT modify the repository or the main checkout.
MUST NOT write .harness/ or any long-term memory.
MUST NOT write routing state (state.json) or the event log (log.ndjson).
MUST NOT write outside its stage directory.
